ambiguities: Le père du narrateur is folded into the same collective source as the mother in the accepted diminishment of Swann ('Ni elle d'ailleurs ni mon père...') and has no distinct local outcome of his own, so he was not scored separately.

Françoise's report of Odette's superstitions ('elle a bien confiance à des médailles...') could be read as a mild discredit of Odette (folk credulity undercutting her social pretensions), but Françoise's own stated tone is admiring ('une personne très croyante'), and the passage stages no reaction from any character to this information; it reads as color/characterization rather than a social-status event, so it was left unscored.

The extended description of the narrator's idolization of Gilberte (the windows 'resembling' her gaze, the concierge, the pilgrimage to her house) is essayistic/poetic reverie about the narrator's own perceiving consciousness rather than a staged social event that positions Gilberte among other characters, so neither Gilberte nor le narrateur was scored for it.
